title: The Great Canon of the Azure Tether
summary: A canon of the great halter that leads a mighty foe and the chain that returns a blow to the striker.

title: Treatise of the Twin-Court Binders
summary: A treatise of two binders working as a court that locks a foe from both sides and seals both ends.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Long Bond
summary: A manual of bonds cast from a height like a hawk's stoop that net a whole field and seize from afar.

title: Canon of the River Held Still
summary: A canon on halting a moving flow of force and bodies with threads that follow the current.

title: The Master Binders' Twin Fetters
summary: A manual for a master of the mortal tier who fetters two foes to each other and turns their struggle on them.

title: The Wind-Sworn Great Binding
summary: A manual of the great binding cast on the wind with no wall to shelter behind and a vow to hold it.

title: Book of the Long Oath
summary: A book of the oath that binds a foe's blows and words together and returns the harm of a broken vow.

title: Plateau Canon of the Unbroken Bearing
summary: A canon of the bearing held level against any pull and the unbroken line that holds a foe by it.

title: Manual of the Open-Handed Bond
summary: A manual of the soft bond made with an open palm that steadies allies and quiets foes without pain.

title: The Sworn Chain of the Master Binders
summary: A manual for a master of the mortal tier who lays a heavy sworn chain on a foe and lets the oath do the holding.
